relationship_to_previous_analysis: Descriptive feature-response-v1 has been observed. This is a new prospective matched postprocessing analysis, not blind confirmation of a selected feature or a modification of the frozen release study.

population.source_ids: library-00 through library-23 then synthetic-00 through synthetic-23 in existing manifest order
population.assignment: All sources and variants are descriptive_development_only; no train, selection, calibration or blind evaluation partition
strata: controlled synthesis with four shared recipe families
population.history_labels: Library baseline remains unknown after every non-codec process; added-codec library cases have known added loss with unknown ancestry. Controlled synthetic baselines with only these processes have no lossy codec stage, irrespective of fidelity loss.

matrix.order: Existing codec round trip, then one postprocessing condition, then PCM quantization and WAV presentation; no new lossy encoding
matrix.baseline_matching: The non-codec-only baseline traverses the same decode, float processing, quantization, WAV write/read and inspection path as each positive case

processing.shared_path: Decode to native signed 16/24-bit stereo integers; map exactly to float64 using 2^(bits-1); FFmpeg float64 filter path; NumPy ties-to-even integer quantization and saturation; write native-rate stereo PCM WAV. Identity must reproduce original PCM and prior public measurements exactly.
processing.gain: FFmpeg volume=-6dB:precision=double; no dither, return to source depth
processing.dither16: Identity float filter, then 16-bit quantization with additive U(0,1)-U(0,1) TPDF in LSB units. NumPy PCG64 seed 20261010 + source manifest index (0..47), two full stereo-shaped draws. Same realization for every codec case of that source, independent draws across channels. No noise shaping.
processing.resample: 44100->48000->44100 or 48000->44100->48000. FFmpeg swr, 64-tap filter_size, phase_shift=10, linear_interp=0, exact_rational=1, cutoff=0.97, Kaiser beta=9, double internal/output precision, no resampler dither. Return to source depth.
processing.lowpass16k: FFmpeg causal two-pole lowpass, f=16000 Hz, Q=0.7071067811865476, direct form I, float64 precision, no coefficient normalization, blocksize=0. This is a 3 dB cutoff, not a brick-wall filter. Return to source depth.
processing.eq_dynamics: FFmpeg 1 kHz peaking EQ, Q=1, gain=-3 dB, direct form I float64, no coefficient normalization, blocksize=0; then downward compressor, input gain=1, threshold=0.125, ratio=2, attack=20 ms, release=250 ms, makeup=1, knee=2.8284271247461903, average stereo linking, RMS detection, sidechain gain=1, mix=1. Return to source depth.
processing.timing: Require exact frame count, no crop, padding, alignment search or source-specific correction. Causal IIR phase change is part of the process. Reset filter state at each excerpt start.
processing.clipping: Count saturated channel samples for every output and aggregate by condition. Retain clipped cases; no source-dependent normalization or exclusion. No clipping-free claim.
processing.not_included: 12 kHz stress filter, shorter excerpts, extra encoders and other transformation strengths

checks: gain RMS within 0.001 of amplitude target
resample impulse peak offset exactly zero in both channels

analysis.features: All twelve fixed comparator measurements, without feature selection or model fitting
analysis.stratification: Separate library and synthetic populations; equal weight per source in descriptive summaries, without claiming source independence
analysis.statistics: Use the preceding prespecified paired_summary: pair/both-present/missing/transition counts, signed-delta counts and median/min/max. Interaction requires all four values; null never becomes zero. Save every condition, setting and feature, including identity sanity comparisons.
analysis.inference: No p-values, significance selection, probability calibration, thresholds, detection rates, commercial false-positive denominator or real-music accuracy claims

execution_and_stopping.failure: Stop on changed input/runtime/binary/control hashes, malformed report, nonfinite samples, frame-count mismatch, identity inequality or resource limit. Retain partial outputs; diagnose and prospectively record any rerun. No silent source dropping.
execution_and_stopping.completion: 2016 validated reports, unchanged bound inputs/toolchain, and the complete prespecified aggregate. This is not completion of the release study.
execution_and_stopping.sample_replay_after_run: Regenerate all six conditions for baseline and MP3-192 on library-00 and synthetic-00 (24 cases), verify exact output PCM and WAV hashes against retained samples; no source selection by feature result

storage.retained_audio: Exactly 24 WAVs: library-00 and synthetic-00, baseline and MP3-192, every condition
storage.scratch_audio: Other newly generated WAVs are removed only after successful PCM readback, hash/report checks and durable per-case report save. Original codec and synthesis artifacts are never removed. Reconstructible from bound inputs, code and seeds.
storage.reports: Retain all private per-case metadata, processing diagnostics, PCM/WAV hashes, input fingerprints and feature reports; Git receives only aggregates and control/implementation records
